description: Figure 8 is a line plot that illustrates the relative change in performance of the Mistral-7B-v0.2 model as a result of layer-wise quantized pruning, with SnapKV as the pruning method. The x-axis represents different layers of the model, labeled from "Layer-4" to "Layer-32-32". The y-axis measures the relative change in performance, ranging from -15% to 3%. The plot includes several lines representing different configurations: "LB-Avg-2 tokens,8-bit" in blue, "LB-Avg-1 tokens,16-bit" in red, "RULER4k of 2 tokens,8-bit" in green, "RULER4k of 1 tokens,16-bit" in orange, and "Baseline of 4 tokens,4-bit" in purple. The lines show various trends, with the "LB-Avg-2 tokens,8-bit" line showing a significant drop in performance at certain layers, while the "Baseline of 4 tokens,4-bit" line remains relatively stable across all layers.
